Body Slam (Japanese: のしかかり Lean On) is a damage-dealing Normal-type move introduced in Generation I. It was TM08 in Generation I. It is TR01 in Generation VIII.

Effect

Generation I

Body Slam inflicts damage and has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target. It cannot paralyze Normal-type Pokémon.

Generations II to V

Body Slam can now paralyze Normal-type Pokémon.

Generation VI onward

If the target has used Minimize, Body Slam now deals double its regular damage and bypasses accuracy checks to always hit, unless the target is in the semi-invulnerable turn of a move such as Dig or Fly.

Description

Games Description
Stad A Normal-type attack. Has a one-in-three chance of paralyzing the target if it connects.
Stad2 A Normal-type attack. Has a one-in-three chance of paralyzing the target if it hits.
GSC An attack that may cause paralysis.
RSEColo.XD A full-body slam that may cause paralysis.
FRLG The user drops its full body on the foe. It may leave the foe paralyzed.
DPPtHGSSPBR The user drops onto the foe with its full body weight. It may leave the foe paralyzed.
BWB2W2 The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. It may also leave the target with paralysis.

In Red Rescue Team and Blue Rescue Team, Body Slam is a move with base power of 12, 17 PP and 100% accuracy. The user targets enemy in front, possibly inflicting paralysis.

In Explorers of Time, Darkness and Sky, the move's accuracy has been decreased to 85%.

Description

Games Description
MDRB Inflicts damage on the target. It may also cause paralysis and prevent any attacks or moves.
MDTDS Inflicts damage on the target. It may also afflict the targeted enemy with a Paralysis status condition. A Pokémon with the Paralysis status has slowed movement and is incapable of action.
BSL てきポケモンに ダメージをあたえる しかも いっていのかくりつで まひじょうたいにかえる まひじょうたいの ポケモンは わざが だせない
Conq. The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. It may also leave the target with paralysis.
MDGtI It damages an enemy. It could also cause the Paralysis status condition. With the Paralysis status, the enemy's Travel Speed goes down and it can't attack or use moves.
SMD It damages an enemy and could also cause paralysis.

  • In Pokémon Double Trouble, Luana told her Marowak to use Body Slam. This was in the dub only, as in the original Japanese version, Luana told Marowak to use Double-Edge instead.
  • In Pruning a Passel of Pals!, an unnamed Coordinator told his Wailmer to use Body Slam, but it was frozen by Dawn's Buneary's Ice Beam before it could execute the move.
